Name: Family Gunner
Source: Lyres Guide to Risk and Reward
Information: Gunners are trained to expertly use firearms at both long and short ranges. They are most commonly employed by the Family as lookouts, assassins, and silent bodyguards.

Stat Blocks.raw_text:
**FAMILY GUNNER**
*Medium humanoid (any), lawful evil*
**AC** 16 (studded leather)
**HP** 88 (12d8 + 34)
**Speed** 30 ft.
**STR** 14 (+2) | **DEX** 18 (+4) | **CON** 14 (+2) | **INT** 16 (+3) | **WIS** 15 (+2) | **CHA** 13 (+1)
**Saving Throws** Con +5, Wis +5
**Skills** Perception +8, Stealth +6
**Senses** passive Perception 18
**Languages** passive Perception 18
**CR** 6 (2300 XP) **Proficiency Bonus** +3

**TRAITS**
*Critical 19*

***Hawkeye.*** The gunner’s ranged attacks ignore half and two-thirds cover.

**ACTIONS**
***Multiattack.*** The gunner makes two attacks, either making two with its scoped rifle, or making one each with their revolver and shortsword.

***Revolver.*** *Ranged Weapon Attack:* +7 to hit, range 20/60 ft., one target. *Hit:* 11 (2d6 + 4) piercing damage plus 7 (2d6) poison damage.

***Shortsword.*** *Melee Weapon Attack:* +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 8 (1d6 + 4) piercing damage plus 7 (2d6) poison damage.

***Scoped Rifle.*** *Ranged Weapon Attack:* +9 to hit, range 60/180, one target. *Hit:* 17 (2d10 + 6) piercing damage. If the gunner is prone when making this attack they have advantage, and don’t suffer disadvantage when firing up to their long range or at prone targets.

**BONUS ACTIONS**
***Trick Short (Recharge 5-6).*** When the gunner hits a creature with a firearm attack, it can choose one of the following effects, and the target must succeed a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw or be subjected to it:
• Their movement speed is reduced to 0 until the end of their next turn.
• They take an additional 18 (4d8) piercing damage.
• The target has disadvantage on attack rolls until the end of their next turn.
• If the target is concentrating on a spell or effect, they must make a DC 15 Constitution saving throw instead, and if they fail they lose concentration.
